preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 2 * 10**5 for N, M, edges, S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of cities N is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= M <= 120000 for N, M, edges, S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of main roads M is between 0 and 120,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N for N, M, edges, S in test_cases for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each main road connects two distinct nodes x and y, both between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(x != y for N, M, edges, S in test_cases for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: For each test case, no main road connects a node to itself.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(edges)) == M for N, M, edges, S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, there are no duplicate main roads.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= S <= N for N, M, edges, S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, Rust's starting position S is between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output[i].split()) == N - 1 for i, (N, M, edges, S) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains N-1 space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(d) >= 0 for d in output[i].split()) for i, (N, M, edges, S) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, all distances in the output are non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(d) <= N - 1 for d in output[i].split()) for i, (N, M, edges, S) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, all distances in the output are at most N-1.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(d) == 0 for d in output[i].split() if int(d) == 0) for i, (N, M, edges, S) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the distance to the starting node S is not included in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(d) == min(int(d) for d in output[i].split()) for d in output[i].split()) for i, (N, M, edges, S) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the distances in the output are in ascending order based on vertex number.
